title: Seoul K-pop pilgrimage: 13 idol-visited cafés and restaurants
desc: A map of Seoul cafés and restaurants linked to K-pop idols, grouped by BTS, SEVENTEEN and other groups, with what to order at each.

items.title: Wasedaya (Ichon)
items.memo: Yakiniku spot visited by BTS's RM in 2025; he left an autograph

items.title: Hwayeon Sanjang (Cheongdam)
items.memo: Galbi restaurant visited by BTS's V; premium galbi is the pick

items.title: Jindaegam Mapo Branch
items.memo: Jungkook has dined here; try chadolbagi with the scallop set

items.title: Yoojung Sikdang (유정식당)
items.memo: BTS's trainee-days restaurant; order the black pork dolsot bibimbap

items.title: Cafe Hyuga (휴가)
items.memo: Cafe in the building of BTS's former dorm; EXO's Kai has visited too

items.title: Geumdwaeji Sikdang (금돼지식당)
items.memo: Michelin-listed pork BBQ visited by Jeonghan; samgyeopsal with perilla kimchi

items.title: Dosan Ttukbaegi (Cheongdam)
items.memo: Mingyu is said to be a regular; order the galbitang

items.title: Daebongjip Sinsa (대봉집)
items.memo: Appeared on a SEVENTEEN livestream; frozen daepae samgyeopsal

items.title: Cafe Onion Anguk
items.memo: Bakery cafe inside a hanok, linked to NCT's Taeyong

items.title: Somunnan Seongsu Gamjatang
items.memo: Gamjatang (pork bone stew) spot linked to Stray Kids' Felix

items.title: Downtowner Hannam
items.memo: Premium burgers; linked to TXT's Soobin and used as an MV filming site

items.title: Seoul Coffee Ikseon
items.memo: Hanok cafe linked to SHINee's Key; ice cream and butter red bean bread

items.title: Yeongcheon Yeonghwa Cheongdam
items.memo: SUPER JUNIOR-linked spot; Korean beef yukhoe bibimbap
